title: A one-press build reaches every CMS with the business's own photos and words: EmDash passes the hand-off, crops are Tracy's arithmetic, a plan grows, an unheard check is not counted, and the check judges photos, icons, forms and module settings as they are
steps: S1: an EmDash client-send build whose site job answers custody skipped, through provision, plan, an amended plan, a check whose caller left, and two checks.
S2: agentImageRecipe on the agent's own row ("500/399", the whole picture as source, an output larger than the crop), on "4:3", and on unusable recipes.
S3: amendsPlan on an image added, a row appended, a row changed, a row dropped, another structure hash, a planned image changed.

S4: briefOf on an agent build; checkCollectedUsed with three crops of one photo; no-demo-pictures over an icon, a PNG mask and a blog photo; no-demo-words over a form's words; a phone followed by a street number.
S5: compareAgentInventory over a JA module config held as JSON with a Joomla picture, after its photo and words change and after an item is added.

S6: stepBudget over forty provision waits; a demo build and an own-site build on one account with a cap of one; an own-site research paused four times; a typed name with a pasted link; nameFromTitle on SEO titles.
expect: S1: ready and planned; the grown plan saves, a rewritten one is AGENT_DEMO_PLAN_FROZEN; the left check is AGENT_DEMO_CHECK_UNHEARD and not counted, the next is counted.
S2: 836×667 crop and output with aspect 500/399; "4:3" reads as 4/3; each unusable recipe is refused with why.
S3: true, true, false, false, false, false.
S4: the research's posts are evidence, its secrets are not; one photo of the place; only the blog photo is a template picture; the form's words pass; the brief's phone passes and another fails.
S5: structure kept after copy and photo; changed after an item is added.
S6: not due; both builds accepted, each counted on its own cap; resumed three times then failed SOURCE_PAUSED; the typed name kept; brand names kept, page words dropped.
fence: the hand-off's custody rule, agentImageRecipe, amendsPlan, the unheard-check refusal, briefOf's evidence, collected-used's photo sources, decoration, form words, pictureValues on JSON, waitsOnProvision, the usage kind, the own-site resumes, mergeProfile's typed name, nameFromTitle

tests: client-send reserves real chat and one native user request before provision
image recipes read the slot shape as written, crop the largest box of it, and never enlarge
image recipes reject arbitrary assets, stretching and malformed canvas before upload, each with why
an agent build's facts check reads its frozen research as evidence, never its reviews
a module config held as JSON keeps its structure when the build changes its photo and words
demo builds and own-site builds each have their own daily cap
Build from my business: its own switch
a pasted URL: its hostname placeholder never wins the name over the site’s own
collected-used: the name, phone, email, street, an opening time, a review and own photos must all show
no-demo-words: a template block still there fails unless its words are the brief’s
facts-from-brief: hours, prices, phones and a founding year the brief holds are shown as held
stepBudget: a demo build waiting on its provision is not looking
nameFromTitle keeps the brand of a home page title
